name: Rocket ridge
description: Longer terrain for 800-unit firing, asymmetric approaches and mixed weapons.

scenarios.name: Rockets: Blue nearer
scenarios.description: Blue starts on the rising side; Red approaches over flatter ground. Both stop to aim once an 800-unit clear firing solution is possible.

scenarios.name: Rockets: Red nearer
scenarios.description: Mirrored uneven approach: Red is nearer the ridge. Watch variable angles, committed arcs and range scatter.

scenarios.name: Red rocket holds crest
scenarios.description: Red holds the ridge; Blue approaches from beyond maximum range, then stops to aim uphill.

scenarios.name: Blue rocket holds crest
scenarios.description: Blue holds the ridge; Red approaches from beyond maximum range, then stops to aim uphill.

scenarios.name: Blue rocket vs rifle
scenarios.description: A Blue rocketeer approaches the ridge while a Red rifleman keeps advancing. Rifle bullets follow their actual uphill/downhill direction.

scenarios.name: Red rocket vs rifle
scenarios.description: Mirrored mixed-weapons approach. The rifle keeps walking; the rocket launcher stops to aim and lead current movement.

scenarios.name: 800-unit rocket exchange
scenarios.description: Both hold exactly 800 units apart. Accuracy is lower at this range; the solver chooses the quickest clear arc for each scattered landing point.
